title: Disturbing the Bridal Room
synopsis: What do you think about this Chinese wedding custom?

fullText.simplified:
闹洞房

    想举办一场完整的中式婚礼，需要什么？特别能喝酒？特别会唱歌？很多钱？都不是，是精力！因为一场完整的中式婚礼会持续一整天，从早晨接新娘开始，到晚上闹洞房结束。随着人们生活习惯的改变，越来越多的人会选择去掉闹洞房这一部分。不仅是因为太累，更多的是态度的改变。
    闹洞房是指在结婚的第一个晚上，所有的亲戚朋友都会到新郎和新娘的房间，也就是洞房。大家在一起玩游戏。游戏分成两队，一队是新郎和新娘，另一队则是亲戚朋友们。输了的队需要完成任务。任务的形式很多样，但目的都是为了结婚的人更快熟悉对方。因为以前都是父母帮忙决定结婚对象，新郎新娘之前并不认识。所以在最初，闹洞房的目的是担心新郎和新娘害羞，用游戏的形式帮助他们更快适应结婚后的生活。但有时候参与游戏的人不能很好控制自己，玩得太过火，变成了一场闹剧，大家都很尴尬。
    因此，近年来越来越多人取消了闹洞房这一部分。同时，和以前不同，现在中国的年轻人都是自由恋爱，结婚以前已经很了解对方了，并不需要这样的活动来帮助他们了解彼此了！
fullText.traditional:
鬧洞房

    想舉辦一場完整的中式婚禮，需要什麼？特別能喝酒？特別會唱歌？很多錢？都不是，是精力！因為一場完整的中式婚禮會持續一整天，從早晨接新娘開始，到晚上鬧洞房結束。隨著人們生活習慣的改變，越來越多的人會選擇去掉鬧洞房這一部分。不僅是因為太累，更多的是態度的改變。
    鬧洞房是指在結婚的第一個晚上，所有的親戚朋友都會到新郎和新娘的房間，也就是洞房。大家在一起玩遊戲。遊戲分成兩隊，一隊是新郎和新娘，另一隊則是親戚朋友們。輸了的隊需要完成任務。任務的形式很多樣，但目的都是為了結婚的人更快熟悉對方。因為以前都是父母幫忙決定結婚對象，新郎新娘之前並不認識。所以在最初，鬧洞房的目的是擔心新郎和新娘害羞，用遊戲的形式幫助他們更快適應結婚後的生活。但有時候參與遊戲的人不能很好控制自己，玩得太過火，變成了一場鬧劇，大家都很尷尬。
    因此，近年來越來越多人取消了鬧洞房這一部分。同時，和以前不同，現在中國的年輕人都是自由戀愛，結婚以前已經很了解對方了，並不需要這樣的活動來幫助他們瞭解彼此了！

sentences.traditional: 特別能喝酒？特別會唱歌？很多錢？都不是，是精力！
sentences.pinyin: tè bié néng hē jiǔ tè bié huì chàng gē hěn duō qián dōu bú shì shì jīng lì
sentences.english: If you want to have a complete Chinese-style wedding, what do you need?

sentences.simplified: 因为一场完整的中式婚礼会持续一整天，从早晨接新娘开始，
sentences.traditional: 因為一場完整的中式婚禮會持續一整天，從早晨接新娘開始，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi yì cháng wán zhěng de zhōng shì hūn lǐ huì chí xù yì zhěng tiān cóng zǎo chén jiē xīn niáng kāi shǐ
sentences.english: To be particularly able to drink? To be especially good at singing songs? A lot of money? None of these, it’s energy!

sentences.english: Because a complete Chinese-style wedding will continue all day, starting from picking up the bride in the morning, ..

sentences.traditional: 隨著人們生活習慣的改變，

sentences.english: .. and finishing by disturbing the privacy of the bridal room in the evening.

sentences.simplified: 越来越多的人会选择去掉闹洞房这一部分。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的人會選擇去掉鬧洞房這一部分。
sentences.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de rén huì xuǎn zé qù diào nào dòng fáng zhè yí bù fèn
sentences.english: Along with people’s changing life habits, ..

sentences.simplified: 不仅是因为太累，更多的是态度的改变。
sentences.traditional: 不僅是因為太累，更多的是態度的改變。
sentences.pinyin: bù jǐn shì yīn wèi tài lèi gèng duō de shì tài du de gǎi biàn
sentences.english: .. more and more people will choose to remove the part of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room.
It’s not just because they’re too tired. It’s more about a change in attitudes.

sentences.traditional: 鬧洞房是指在結婚的第一個晚上，
sentences.pinyin: nào dòng fáng shì zhǐ zài jié hūn de dì yī ge wǎn shang

sentences.simplified: 所有的亲戚朋友都会到新郎和新娘的房间，也就是洞房。
sentences.traditional: 所有的親戚朋友都會到新郎和新娘的房間，也就是洞房。

sentences.english: Disturbing the privacy of the bridal room refers to on the first night of a marriage, ..

sentences.simplified: 大家在一起玩游戏。
sentences.traditional: 大家在一起玩遊戲。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā zài yì qǐ wán yóu xì
sentences.english: .. all of the friends and relatives will gather in the room of the bride and the groom, that is the bridal room.

sentences.simplified: 游戏分成两队，一队是新郎和新娘，另一队则是亲戚朋友们。
sentences.traditional: 遊戲分成兩隊，一隊是新郎和新娘，另一隊則是親戚朋友們。
sentences.pinyin: yóu xì fēn chéng liǎng duì yí duì shì xīn láng hé xīn niáng lìng yí duì zé shì qīn qi péng you men
sentences.english: Everyone will play games together.

sentences.simplified: 输了的队需要完成任务。
sentences.traditional: 輸了的隊需要完成任務。
sentences.pinyin: shū le de duì xū yào wán chéng rèn wu
sentences.english: To play you split into two teams. One team is the bride and groom and the other team is the relatives and friends.

sentences.simplified: 任务的形式很多样，但目的都是为了结婚的人更快熟悉对方。
sentences.traditional: 任務的形式很多樣，但目的都是為了結婚的人更快熟悉對方。
sentences.pinyin: rèn wu de xíng shì hěn duō yàng dàn mù dì dōu shì wèi le jié hūn de rén gèng kuài shú xī duì fāng
sentences.english: The losing team has to complete tasks.

sentences.simplified: 因为以前都是父母帮忙决定结婚对象，
sentences.traditional: 因為以前都是父母幫忙決定結婚對象，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi yǐ qián dōu shì fù mǔ bāng máng jué dìng jié hūn duì xiàng
sentences.english: The tasks come in many forms, but their purpose is always for the married couple to get to know each other more quickly.

sentences.simplified: 新郎新娘之前并不认识。
sentences.traditional: 新郎新娘之前並不認識。
sentences.pinyin: xīn láng xīn niáng zhī qián bìng bú rèn shi
sentences.english: In the past, because marriage partners were always decided with the help of the parents, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以在最初，闹洞房的目的是担心新郎和新娘害羞，
sentences.traditional: 所以在最初，鬧洞房的目的是擔心新郎和新娘害羞，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zài zuì chū nào dòng fáng de mù dì shì dān xīn xīn láng hé xīn niáng hài xiū
sentences.english: .. the bride and groom didn’t know each other at all in advance.

sentences.simplified: 用游戏的形式帮助他们更快适应结婚后的生活。
sentences.traditional: 用遊戲的形式幫助他們更快適應結婚後的生活。
sentences.pinyin: yòng yóu xì de xíng shì bāng zhù tā men gèng kuài shì yìng jié hūn hòu de shēng huó
sentences.english: So at first, the purpose of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room was a worry that the bride and groom would be shy , ..

sentences.simplified: 但有时候参与游戏的人不能很好控制自己，
sentences.traditional: 但有時候參與遊戲的人不能很好控制自己，
sentences.pinyin: dàn yǒu shí hou cān yù yóu xì de rén bù néng hěn hǎo kòng zhì zì jǐ
sentences.english: .. so games were used as a way to help them adapt to married life more quickly.

sentences.simplified: 玩得太过火，变成了一场闹剧，大家都很尴尬。
sentences.traditional: 玩得太過火，變成了一場鬧劇，大家都很尷尬。
sentences.pinyin: wán de tài guò huǒ biàn chéng le yì cháng nào jù dà jiā dōu hěn gān gà
sentences.english: But sometimes people that participate in the games aren’t able to control themselves very well.
Taking the games too far makes them into a farce, making everyone very embarrassed.

sentences.simplified: 因此，近年来越来越多人取消了闹洞房这一部分。
sentences.traditional: 因此，近年來越來越多人取消了鬧洞房這一部分。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ jìn nián lái yuè lái yuè duō rén qǔ xiāo le nào dòng fáng zhè yí bù fèn

sentences.simplified: 同时，和以前不同，现在中国的年轻人都是自由恋爱，
sentences.traditional: 同時，和以前不同，現在中國的年輕人都是自由戀愛，
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí hé yǐ qián bù tóng xiàn zài zhōng guó de nián qīng rén dōu shì zì yóu liàn ài
sentences.english: Consequently, in recent years more and more people have canceled the part of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room.

sentences.simplified: 结婚以前已经很了解对方了，
sentences.traditional: 結婚以前已經很了解對方了，
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn yǐ qián yǐ jīng hěn liǎo jiě duì fāng le
sentences.english: At the same time, unlike in the past, nowadays young people in China can all choose their spouses freely.

sentences.simplified: 并不需要这样的活动来帮助他们了解彼此了！
sentences.traditional: 並不需要這樣的活動來幫助他們瞭解彼此了！
sentences.pinyin: bìng bù xū yào zhè yàng de huó dòng lái bāng zhù tā men liǎo jiě bǐ cǐ le
sentences.english: They already know each other well before they get married, ..
.. and don’t need this kind of exercise to help them get to know one another at all!

raw.synopsis: What do you think about this Chinese wedding custom?
sentence_translations: Disturbing the Privacy of the Bridal Room
If you want to have a complete Chinese-style wedding, what do you need?
To be particularly able to drink? To be especially good at singing songs? A lot of money? None of these, it’s energy!
Because a complete Chinese-style wedding will continue all day, starting from picking up the bride in the morning, ..
.. and finishing by disturbing the privacy of the bridal room in the evening.
Along with people’s changing life habits, ..
.. more and more people will choose to remove the part of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room.
It’s not just because they’re too tired. It’s more about a change in attitudes.
Disturbing the privacy of the bridal room refers to on the first night of a marriage, ..
.. all of the friends and relatives will gather in the room of the bride and the groom, that is the bridal room.
Everyone will play games together.
To play you split into two teams. One team is the bride and groom and the other team is the relatives and friends.
The losing team has to complete tasks.
The tasks come in many forms, but their purpose is always for the married couple to get to know each other more quickly.
In the past, because marriage partners were always decided with the help of the parents, ..
.. the bride and groom didn’t know each other at all in advance.
So at first, the purpose of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room was a worry that the bride and groom would be shy , ..
.. so games were used as a way to help them adapt to married life more quickly.
But sometimes people that participate in the games aren’t able to control themselves very well.
Taking the games too far makes them into a farce, making everyone very embarrassed.
Consequently, in recent years more and more people have canceled the part of disturbing the privacy of the bridal room.
At the same time, unlike in the past, nowadays young people in China can all choose their spouses freely.
They already know each other well before they get married, ..
.. and don’t need this kind of exercise to help them get to know one another at all!
